# Vendored miniz inflate

Only the raw inflate (`tinfl`) part of miniz is vendored, for extracting VPKs.

Upstream: https://github.com/richgel999/miniz
Vendored tag: `3.1.2`

Local changes:

- `miniz_tinfl.c` includes `miniz_tinfl.h` instead of the amalgamated
  `miniz.h`.
- `miniz_export.h` is hand-written instead of generated by CMake.
